title: Framework SQL built from input (mongoose) — review required
description: A mongoose data call assembles SQL from parts: find({$where: q}). Framework helpers do not sanitize interpolated values. This lexical rule flags the assembly; the reviewer confirms every part is trusted or parameterizes it.
remediation: Use the framework's binding (operator queries); never interpolate values.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any assembled query matches, including trusted ones.
